exposure: prolonged duration of the second stage of labor
cohort: The study included 220 women who had a vaginal delivery.
finding: Prolonged duration of the second stage of labor, presence of episiotomy, perineal tear, instrumental delivery, and birth weight >3.8 kg were identified as risk factors for postpartum urinary retention after vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery was found to be a risk factor for postpartum urinary retention.
birth_weight: >3.8 kg was identified as a risk factor for postpartum urinary retention.
